messages:
Incident Bot: PagerDuty ALERT (P1) - capacity-critical: inflight-queue length > 1800 for service/redwood-inference-hosted (threshold 500). page: https://pd.example/incidents/INC-1754321000 :rotating_light:
Carmen (oncall): Acked. I'm jumping in. Any customer-facing errors seen yet?
Ajay: Seeing huge request latency spikes, many 503s from the router -> inference workers. Metrics: 99th latency jumped from 400ms to 6.2s. Error rate 5.8% over last 3m.
Ken: autoscaler logs show repeated scale-outs but no new nodes land. Looks like provider quota soft-fail and spot pool provisioning timeout.
Liam: I can confirm cloud events: provisioning stalled, "Insufficient capacity" for spot requests. New node requests in Pending for >4m.
Carmen (oncall): Customer impact: several small PLG customers seeing errors and rate-limited fallbacks. Not full outage but degraded. Please triage fast.
Ajay: Pasting cluster-autoscaler events snippet:
```
I0304 15:24:01 cluster-autoscaler: Attempting to scale up: nodegroup gpu-pool-eu-west1 (min=2, max=20) current=12
I0304 15:24:12 cloudprovider: Launching instances failed: InsufficientInstanceCapacity
W0304 15:24:15 cluster-autoscaler: Failed to launch 3 nodes for gpu-pool-eu-west1: capacityError
```
Ken: Our node group is already at per-group max (20) and cloud quota for GPUs is at org limit. Autoscaler keeps requesting but provider rejects.
Carmen (oncall): Can we open a manual burst pool or fallback to lower-capacity model variants?
Ajay: Two-pronged: 1) create temporary CPU-backed fallback pool and route low-priority traffic there (reduce quality but keep latency). 2) Request quota increase with cloud provider but that'll be slow.
Liam: I'm rolling a manual node-pool with cheaper GPU type (if available) and toggling scheduling to evict low-priority pods onto CPU nodes. Running this now:
```
kubectl apply -f manifests/temp-cpu-pool.yaml
kubectl -n infra patch deploy router -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"routing/force-refresh":"$(date +%s)"}}}}}'
```
Carmen (oncall): Good. Ajay can you patch the route rules so model-serving endpoints with latency < 100ms SLO stay pinned to existing nodes? We want graceful degradation.
Ajay: On it. Will change route weight: 80% to high-performance model, 20% to fallback quantized model for overflow. Pushing config in 60s.
Ken: Also temporarily increased autoscaler max from 20 -> 30 to let requests through if provider can satisfy. Patch applied. Note: still depends on provider capacity.
Incident Bot: PagerDuty: INC-1754321000 acknowledged by Carmen (oncall). Escalation timers paused.
Liam: New CPU node pool created and cordon/evict hooks in place. Router reconfigured. Early signs: inflight-queue length down from 1800 -> 900 over 2m. Error rate lowering to 2.1%.
Carmen (oncall): Nice. Tracking customer impact: estimated 12% of requests served with degraded model (quantized), affecting quality-sensitive customers. Notifying Support to message top 5 customers.
Ajay: Monitoring logs for any further provisioning failures. If spot pool remains stuck, we'll keep fallback routing for 30m and keep node pool.
Ken: Creating ticket with cloud provider for capacity/quotas now (ref INC-1754321000).
Carmen (oncall): If things stabilize, I'll hand off to Ken for the next shift in 30m. Ken, you'll handle postmortem and quota follow-up?
Ken: Yep — I'll take incident owner after handoff. Will capture timeline and mitigation steps.
Carmen (oncall): TL;DR for handoff -> Cause: provider spot capacity + nodegroup max hit; Impact: transient 5-6% 503s, some degraded quality routing at ~12% of requests; Mitigation: manual CPU pool + fallback model routing + temporary autoscaler max bump.
Liam: Adding Grafana snapshots & logs to the incident thread.
Incident Bot: PagerDuty: INC-1754321000 - marked resolved by Carmen (oncall)? (manual resolve pending confirmation) :thumbsup:
Carmen (oncall): Not resolving yet. Will wait 30m and then if stable escalate closure. Handing to Ken.
Ken: Taking over. I'll post the postmortem draft and timeline later today. Thanks team :heart:
